description: Resolve a collection, creator, or track by name. Returns an exact match id, needs_input with candidates when ambiguous, or needs_input when nothing matches. Never creates resources and never silently picks among duplicates. When type is track and collection_id is omitted, the organization default collection is searched. Requires AudioDN OAuth sign-in (call adn_sign_in or complete account login first).
name: adn_find_resource
